name: model-router
description: Routes each subagent to the cheapest Claude model that can do its task, judged by TypeSafe Jev

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Sent only to https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone as the bearer token. Get one at https://console.typesafe.ai/keys.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: suggest: log the model Jev would pick, change nothing. auto: set the model; this also overrides a model pinned in an agent definition, only a model passed in the Agent call is kept.
